# Hototahitanga

<!-- Generated by `vp run sync:compatibility`. Do not edit by hand; run the writer and commit. -->

Kei runga i tēnei whārangi ngā pūtake Instructure UI i whakatauhia e tēnei hanga pantoken, me ngā kaiwhakamahi e whakamahi ana i aua mea. He rerekē ngā putanga whāinga: e kī ana anake ngā tuku kua tirotirohia, ā, me arotake ngā tuku hou ake i te tuku kua oti te whakamana. Whakahaerehia anō mā `vp run sync:compatibility`; ka whati te tirohanga `gate:compatibility` mēnā ka rere ke.

## Pūtake a runga

Ko ngā tokehohoho hoahoa, ngā tohu ā-tae ritenga a Instructure, me te rārangi Lucide e whāngai ana i te token IR kua whakatauhia e ia mōkihi. Ka whakamahia ngā mōkihi React `@instructure/ui-*` anake e
`@pantoken/react-markdown`.

## Arotake i ngā whakaputanga whāinga

Ko te mahinga ā-wiki mō ngā whakaputanga whāinga e whakatuwhera ana i tētahi take arotake mō ngā whakaputanga WordPress hōu me ngā taiao e whai mātāpono ana i tētahi npm peer. Mō ētahi atu whāinga, ka tirotirohia e ngā kaitiaki ngā rīpene tuarautanga mana o ia papa ā-wiki, ā, ka whakatuwhera i tētahi take arotake ā-ringa; kāore e tohu ana te kore o tētahi take he tautoko i tētahi tuku hou. Hei torohū i tētahi kī:

1. Tirohia te wetereo putanga whakaputanga me ngā panonitanga whakauru, me te adapter kei tēnei ripanga.
2. Whakahaerehia te whakahau hototahi a te adapter me te tuku kōwhiringa, hei tauira
   `vp run @pantoken/postcss#check:compatibility -- 8.5.29`. Ko te whakahau taunoa e pānui ana i ia
   `testedVersions` entriy i tēnei rehitatanga; ka whakaaetia ērā taiao kua honoa ngā āpure hoa.
3. Mō ngā kaitono i kitea mā te whāngai, whakamahia `vp run downstream:test`; ka puritia ngā whakamātautau i kāore i angitū ki `scripts/release/downstream-compatibility.json`. I muri i te arotake angitu, whakahaerehia
   `vp run downstream:bless --package @pantoken/name --version x.y.z` kia whakahoutia te ki.
4. Whakahaerehia he tangata host tūturu, he whakamātautau kaiwhakawhanake, rānei he whakamātautau taputapu hanga i te putanga iti rawa me te tuku hou. Mēnā ka tika, whakatikahia te hōputu putanga whakauru; kaua e tāpiri i ngā kaiwhakawhiwhi hītori e rua hei ara.
5. Whakahoutia `scripts/release/target-compatibility.json` anake i muri i ngā whakamātautau kua angitū, katahi ka whakahaere `vp run sync:compatibility`, hanga anō i ngā tuhinga API Ingarihi, ā, tāpiri he changeset. Ka noho whakatāngia ngā whakaputanga hou kia tae ra ano te panoni arotake nei. Ka rongoāhia ngā tuhinga reo kē ā-rohe mā te whakahaere rānei.

## Ngā whakakore (Deprecations)

Ko ngā toke i tangohia e ngā pūtake i runga ake ā, engari kei te tuku tonu a pantoken hei kaitiaki hototahi. Ka noho ia kia mahi kia tae rā ki te wā ka whai i te `Removed in` minor o runga ake, ā, ka whakamutua te kaitiaki, ā, ka tukua he minor kaihoko. Ka arahina te kaitiaki mā te tuku ki tētahi toke `Replacement` rānei kia mau tonu te uara o te wā kua mohiotia.
